description: THE FINAL FLAME MORI’S HOLIDAY SEASON TEPPAN DINNER Ring in the festive season with an unforgettable culinary journey at Mori Teppanyaki Ubud. Each course, from treasures of the sea to delights of the land, is crafted to celebrate togetherness and joy. Then, on December 31, experience The Final Flame — an exclusive New Year’s Eve 8-course dinner that closes the year with dramatic teppan flair, intimate ambiance, and flavors designed to leave lasting memories. From the first bite to the final sweet note, this is more than dinner — it’s Ubud’s most refined holiday celebration.
